summary: Frontend E2E for Iter 568 (Audit Trail) + Iter 569 (2FA/MFA login) on Expo web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). PASSING: password login on /admin-pin-login (Password tab) correctly redirects super_admin to /verify-2fa with pending_token, masked email s*****@gmail.com, mobile ******3960, 30s resend countdown, WhatsApp/SMS alt buttons visible and disabled with '— not configured' suffix. Wrong OTP 000000 shows 'Invalid OTP. Please check the OTP and try again.' inline and stays on /verify-2fa. Mongo hash-swap + OTP 123456 successfully verifies → session token issued → redirect to admin dashboard /. Users Log Report (/users-log-report) renders all 6 summary cards (Total/Created/Updated/Deleted/Logins/Failed), search filter 'OTP_VERIFICATION' filters rows instantly, clicking a log row opens the View Details modal with IP/Device/Status fields and closes cleanly, and the log surfaces 2FA audit events (LOGIN OTP_VERIFICATION_SUCCESS, OTP_VERIFICATION_FAILED, /auth/2fa/verify). Security · 2FA/MFA page (/security-2fa) renders the 'My Security' card correctly (2FA Status ENABLED (mandatory), masked email/mobile, preferred method chips including WHATSAPP/SMS '(not configured)', Logout from all devices) and Trusted Devices card. FAILING (blocker for one of the required test steps): the entire Super-Admin block (2FA Policy, OTP Length / Validity / Resend Cooldown / Max Attempts fields, Email/WhatsApp/SMS/Trusted-Device toggles, WhatsApp OTP Provider card, SMS OTP Provider card, Save Security Settings button) never renders on the page. Root cause: race condition in /app/frontend/app/security-2fa.tsx — useEffect(() => { load(); }, []) runs once at mount and inside load() the branch `if (isSuper) { … setSt(s) }` uses the CURRENT closure value of isSuper. On a fresh navigation the AuthContext user is still null at mount, so isSuper=false, the GET /api/admin/security-settings/2fa call is never issued, st remains null and the `{isSuper && st ? … : null}` block below the Trusted Devices card is never rendered. Backend logs confirm the request is missing entirely on this navigation. First iteration of the test happened to work because user was already cached from the preceding dashboard fetch; second iteration cold-navigated straight to /security-2fa and reproduced the bug. This blocks the required 'change resend cooldown 30→31 → save → reload → verify persistence → revert' test.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition — useEffect fires with empty deps and reads isSuper before AuthContext.user hydrates, so GET /api/admin/security-settings/2fa is never called and the 2FA Policy card, provider config cards and Save button never render. Reproduces reliably on cold navigation. Reference: /app/frontend/app/security-2fa.tsx:43-60 and :213

integration_issues.issue: Could not test PUT /api/admin/security-settings/2fa from UI because the settings block never rendered (see ui_bugs). Blocked required test step: change resend cooldown 30→31 → save → reload → persist → revert.

action_items: Fix race condition in /app/frontend/app/security-2fa.tsx: change useEffect(() => { load(); }, []) to depend on `user` (or on `isSuper`), e.g. `useEffect(() => { if (user) load(); }, [user])`. This will re-run load() once AuthContext.user is populated and issue GET /api/admin/security-settings/2fa for super_admin.
After the fix, re-verify the 30→31 resend cooldown save + reload persistence + revert to 30 flow.

Consider adding a guarded render (e.g. show a spinner or 'Loading…' placeholder) while user is null instead of silently rendering only the shared cards — improves UX and makes the race less confusing.

rca_of_issue: Bug: Super-admin 2FA settings panel invisible on /security-2fa. Reproduction: (1) Log in as super_admin via password + 2FA. (2) Navigate to /security-2fa. (3) Wait 7 seconds. Expected: 2FA Policy, WhatsApp Provider, SMS Provider, Save Security Settings all render. Actual: only 'My Security' and 'Trusted Devices' cards render; backend never receives GET /api/admin/security-settings/2fa. Root cause: in /app/frontend/app/security-2fa.tsx, useEffect runs load() once on mount with empty deps. Inside load(), the guard `if (isSuper) { … setSt(s) }` closes over the initial render's isSuper value. AuthContext.user is null at initial mount on a cold navigation, so isSuper=false and the third API call is skipped. Since load() never re-runs when user hydrates, st stays null and `{isSuper && st ? … : null}` never becomes truthy. First test run appeared to work only because a prior dashboard fetch had cached the user before navigation — a false negative. Mitigation: change deps to [user] and gate the call inside load() with `if (user)`.
